objective.primaryRule: the actual-profit role of the informed selectable set at C24 (qualified four-component members: unchanged combined controls, staged combinations, the informed refinement's and the independent lane's shortlists): the highest development centre net; ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre drawdown, then the label (PROTOCOL.md §12.3); no qualified member: no qualified combined result

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: planned base schedule (PROTOCOL.md §11.5, §13.4): arm D per cutoff 4 cells × (4,096 screened + 3 × 1,024 island proposals + ≈ 1,000 refinement moves) ≈ 32,800 distinct centres, ≈ 313,000 evaluations (≈ 383,000 with every extension island), identical at C19/C21/C23/C24; arm B (C24) ≈ 14,800 centres / 130,000 evaluations; arm C (C24) ≈ 4,700 centres / 82,000 evaluations; qualification ≈ 1,500 evaluations per member. Reports count centres, neighbours per rung, earlier-fold work, retries and archive hits separately; the actual counts come from the sealed search records.

deviations.description: the primary rule is actual profit (the actual-profit role) with a frozen deterministic tie-break; robust-profit, balanced and lower-drawdown roles reported beside it
deviations.justification: brief §5 requires actual marked net profit as the primary rank among qualifying combined candidates

deviations.description: one allocation architecture (A, one exclusive funded slot); the family priority at a same-instant tie is the only allocation gene; symbols tie alphabetically
deviations.justification: brief §2: architecture A is the primary combined architecture; capacity-sharing schemes belong to Priority 5

deviations.description: Study 8's pipeline with three NSGA-II objectives (−centre net, −robust net, p90 DD) and rung promotion reserving ¼ for centre net and ¼ for robust net
deviations.justification: brief §5: preserve actual-profit promotion alongside robust ranking (standard §2.4)

deviations.description: neighbourhood scopes: whole pool, each family, each symbol (128 draws each); the Growth pair: each Growth book
deviations.justification: brief §5 asks for whole-pool and family/symbol perturbation scopes

deviations.description: zero-tolerance parity against the canonical engines where they exist (D1 pair: runNAllocator; Growth: runRiseTrading; one-symbol pools: Priority 2's frozen engine); cross-symbol D1 + Growth pools against an independent reference implementation within $1e-6
deviations.justification: no canonical engine exists for a cross-symbol D1 + Growth pool

deviations.description: stricter door: FULL never opens before the committed frozen selection, not even for the controls' known full-history targets, which are compared at the validation stage
deviations.justification: brief §3: compare known full-history targets at the final validation stage

deviations.description: the four arms are not budget-matched against one another (arm D is matched across cutoffs); inherited search effort is disclosed; no method-superiority claim
deviations.justification: the arms answer different questions (brief §4); the limitation is stated

deviations.description: the earlier-cutoff repetition covers the independent four-component procedure (arm D) only; the Growth-pair search (arm B) runs at C24 only; the staged path and the informed refinement are informed (VG #2) and get no chronological test; no chronological staged-versus-joint method claim
deviations.justification: regenerating VG #2's two-book D1 pool at every cutoff is outside the frozen budget
deviations.userAgreement: brief §6: 'if this extra procedure comparison is outside the frozen budget, limit the claim instead'
